title: SOC 2 readiness
provenance: Criteria identifiers and short original topic labels for the 2017 Trust Services Criteria with the 2022 revised points of focus, and the 2018 description criteria with 2022 implementation guidance (https://www.aicpa-cima.com/resources/download/get-description-criteria-for-your-organizations-soc-2-r-report). No licensed AICPA text is reproduced. The 2017 criteria apply to periods ending on or after 2018-12-15; the 2022 revision month is recorded as its publication date. The October 2026 exposure draft (https://www.aicpa-cima.com/news/article/aicpa-proposes-update-of-soc-2-r-trust-services-criteria-to-enhance-the-relevance-usability-and-value-of-cpas-reports) is not operative here.
license: Apache-2.0 for original MoonMind summaries. Referenced standards retain their own rights.
conclusions: SOC 2 readiness. An independent CPA issues the examination report.

externalClaims.gap: No CPA examination or issued SOC 2 report was performed.
externalClaims.nextStep: Engage an independent CPA firm for a Type 1 or Type 2 SOC 2 examination of the recorded service boundary and period.

externalClaims.gap: Practitioner independence has not been established.
externalClaims.verifiableBy: Independent CPA firm under AICPA independence rules
externalClaims.nextStep: Obtain the examining firm's independence confirmation for this engagement.

externalClaims.gap: Attributions and synthetic verification do not establish this organisation's real-world readiness.
externalClaims.verifiableBy: Service organisation management with its independent CPA
externalClaims.nextStep: Have the examining CPA test the recorded design and operating evidence and samples.

limitations: SOC 2 readiness only, not certification or an issued examination report.
Technical findings and agent recommendations cannot establish design, historical operation, populations or organisational events.
Recorded reviews and sample choices are attributed inputs, not independent assessor conclusions.
